採用・広告の製品.quote: Heat Protection Materials:

Brandenburger develops and produces customized insulation solutions for almost any application. The high-performance insulation materials excel for the insulation characteristics and outstanding mechanical properties.

Drilling, milling, sanding, grinding – these are just a few of the machining methods that they use to produce the perfect solution. From a standard cut to components with highly complex geometries – Brandenburger and Inserco prepare the materials specifically for the requirements of the clients.

The finishing methods improve the materials even further while simultaneously offering you enhanced process reliability. The FP-BRA coating protects the composites against oil and moisture ingress, significantly extending the material’s service life.

Reliability of production is one of the keywords of Inserco und Brandenburger for the wood- processing industry. There are hardly any other areas where presses are exposed to such high thermal loads. The heat protection systems protect the components of the systems, ensure product quality, and help prevent machine downtime.
Insulation solutions for the rubber-processing industry

The requirements for energy efficiency, product quality and process reliability in the rubber- processing industry are extremely high. This is why Brandenburger has succeeded for many years as a specialized supplier of heat protection materials for renowned manufacturers of tires, conveyor belts, and rubber products in general.

Companies from all over the world, such as Dieffenbacher, Continental, Bridgestone, Wemhöner, Kronospan, Harburg-Freudenberger, etc. trust and rely on the excellent service and products of Brandenburger.

Semi-finished Products, Technical Parts and Reinforced Plastics
S 4000® is a thermoset plastic reinforced with glass fibres. The unique composition ensures excellent insulating properties in combination with excellent mechanical and thermal strength.

S 4000® is used as a thermal insulation board or as a mechanical component for heated presses and tools in the plastics and rubber processing industry where excellent insulation properties are required.
XGD® 60 is a thermoset plastic reinforced with glass fibres. The unique composition ensures excellent insulating properties in combination with excellent mechanical and thermal strength.

XGD® 60 is used as a thermal insulation board or as a mechanical component for heated presses and tools in the plastics and rubber processing industry where high compressive strength and dimensional stability are required.
XGD® 15 is a thermoset plastic reinforced with glass fibres. The unique composition ensures excellent insulating properties.
XGD® 15 is used as a thermal outside insulation board for tools in the plastics and rubber processing industry.

Reference: Brandenburger Isoliertechnik-Accelerate digitalization with focused process optimization
Accelerate digitalization with focused process optimization
PROTEMA supported the company
to optimize all planning and order processing processes and to align these to best practices as preparation for the implementation of a new ERP software.

In the context of comprehensive measures to increase service quality and flexibility towards the customer, a multi-stage project was set up. The goal of the overall project was the complete digitalization of all planning and order processing processes. The digitalization should be achieved by an ERP solution (Enterprise Resource Planning) that operates as far as possible with standard functions.

2. Next project phase: The target of a future project phase is adjusting the IT architecture. An essential part of this phase is the implementation of an ERP solution. The existing Enterprise Resource Planning and Production Planning System represents well the business transactions so far. However, more effective software functions are needed to implement the planned level of service.
Processes and solutions
Analysis of the currently used business processes
Detailed view of the production control system
Process analysis in the shop floor
Comparison of current processes against best practices
Alignment of the processes of Brandenburger Isoliertechnik with other companies of the Brandenburger Group
Preparation of a detailed requirement specification
Optimization of the business processes
Replacement of unnecessary customizations with business management and industry-typical standards (where appropriate)
Harmonization of processes within the Brandenburger Group, thereby streamlining of the requirements for business software

It is difficult for companies to understand that long cherished processes can be further optimized and even standardized. Brandenburger took the chance to overcome this hurdle and trusted PROTEMA to find a working approach. With a lot of openness and trust from all team members, this hurdle could be overcome. The meeting on the same eye level was a lot of fun.
